nodes.label: Itinerary Engine
nodes.rationale: Ensures generated daily itineraries are realistic by summing visit duration, travel transit time, meals, and rest rather than assembling an impractical list of places.

nodes.label: Route Optimization Engine
nodes.rationale: Models travel scheduling as a Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) with multi-variable constraints to eliminate redundant back-and-forth transit.

nodes.label: Budget Engine
nodes.rationale: Distributes travel expenses dynamically by travel style percentage allocations and triggers actionable downgrades when budget limits are exceeded.

nodes.label: Weather Integration
nodes.rationale: Weather data is not purely visual; it actively serves as an optimization input to dynamically swap outdoor destinations with indoor alternatives.

nodes.label: Recommendation Scoring Model
nodes.rationale: Uses weighted multi-factor ranking (preference 30%, budget fit 20%, distance 15%, popularity 10%, weather fit 10%, time fit 10%, experience 5%) to score candidates.

nodes.label: TripCraft Tech Stack Architecture
nodes.rationale: Fullstack Next.js combined with TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle provides unified type safety across front-end presentation and back-end logic.

nodes.label: Product Architecture Principle
nodes.rationale: Never use LLM as calculator or routing engine. LLM is restricted to reasoning, recommendation, and natural conversation, while backend handles deterministic math, routing, and validation to prevent hallucinations.

nodes.label: Alternative Itinerary Scenarios
nodes.rationale: Generates multiple budget tier alternatives (cheapest, balanced, comfort) without requiring the user to recreate itineraries from scratch.
